package rulefixtures

import (
	"log"
	"net/http"
	"time"
)

// scenario for middleware_type_outside_middleware_package: Shared middleware types and constructors declared in handlers or services instead of a middleware-focused package.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: info.

type LoggingMiddleware struct {
	logger *log.Logger
	prefix string
}

func NewLoggingMiddleware(logger *log.Logger, prefix string) *LoggingMiddleware {
	return &LoggingMiddleware{logger: logger, prefix: prefix}
}

func (lm *LoggingMiddleware) Wrap(next http.Handler) http.Handler {
	return http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		start := time.Now()
		lm.logger.Printf("%s %s %s", lm.prefix, r.Method, r.URL.Path)

		next.ServeHTTP(w, r)

		lm.logger.Printf("%s %s completed in %v", lm.prefix, r.URL.Path, time.Since(start))
	})
}

func OrderServiceHandler(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	lm := NewLoggingMiddleware(log.Default(), "[order-service]")
	dummy := http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
	})
	lm.Wrap(dummy).ServeHTTP(w, r)
}

var _ = time.Now
